vault.banner.sign_in_again: Your sign-in has ended. Sign in again to keep your changes in sync.
vault.dialog.delete_body: The item is removed from the vault on every device. This cannot be undone.
vault.dialog.missing_body: The server no longer shows this item, so it cannot be kept in sync. The copy on this device is removed for good, and nothing is uploaded again. If you only want to wait, cancel and leave it as it is.

vault.edit.name: Name
vault.edit.not_editable: This item cannot be changed right now. Open it to see why.
vault.edit.notes_help: The notes stay hidden until you ask for them.
vault.edit.password_keep: Leave empty to keep the current password.
vault.edit.title: Edit item
vault.error.clipboard: The clipboard could not be used. Show the value and copy it by hand.

vault.error.item_changed: The item changed while the page was open. Reload it and try again.

vault.error.throttled: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.
vault.error.worker_failed: The part of the page that holds your keys stopped. Reload the page and try again.

vault.item.totp_note: This item has a one-time password set up. It is kept safe but not shown in this version.
